name: @kitora/collab
description: Kitora's real-time collaboration primitives: presence with idle and away, live cursors, shared selection highlights, follow mode and an undo/redo history with time travel, over a transport-agnostic adapter (BroadcastChannel, in-memory, Yjs awareness).

exports.name: channelPresence
exports.description: Presence over any {@link CollabTransport}: full-state messages, a heartbeat, and a timeout for clients that vanish.

exports.name: HEARTBEAT_MS
exports.description: Re-send our state this often so late joiners and timeouts work (ms).

exports.name: PEER_TIMEOUT_MS
exports.description: Drop a client not heard from for this long (ms): a crashed tab never says goodbye.

exports.name: PRESENCE_MESSAGE_KINDS
exports.description: Wire message kinds of {@link channelPresence}. Canonical list.

exports.name: PRESENCE_NAMESPACE
exports.description: Marker on every message so a shared channel can carry other traffic too.

exports.name: systemClock
exports.description: The real clock.

exports.name: ChannelPresenceOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link channelPresence}.

exports.name: CollabClock
exports.description: Timing knobs injectable for tests; defaults are the platform timers.

exports.name: PresenceAdapter

exports.description: Decide follow for `surface` while following `clientId`. Following yourself, or a client that left, stops.

exports.name: FOLLOW_ACTIONS
exports.description: Follow outcomes. Canonical list.

exports.description: True when two viewports are the same within half a pixel and 0.1% zoom (no re-apply loops).

exports.name: FollowDecision
exports.description: What a follower should do.

exports.name: createHistory
exports.description: Create an empty history.

exports.name: HISTORY_LIMIT

exports.name: MERGE_WINDOW_MS

exports.name: colorFor
exports.description: A deterministic palette colour for any id (same user, same colour, on every client).

exports.name: comparePeers
exports.description: Self first, then by user name, then client id: a stable order for avatars that does not jump as states update.

exports.name: FALLBACK_COLOR
exports.description: Colour used when a peer publishes something that is not a hex colour.

exports.name: initials
exports.description: Up to two initials from a display name ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL").

exports.name: isRecord
exports.description: Whether `x` is a plain object (not null, not an array).

exports.name: luminance
exports.description: WCAG relative luminance of a hex colour (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa; alpha ignored), or null for anything else.

exports.name: MAX_NAME_LENGTH
exports.description: Longest display name kept (a peer could publish a novel).

exports.name: MAX_SELECTION
exports.description: Most selected ids kept per peer (a forged state could carry millions).

exports.name: MAX_SURFACE_LENGTH
exports.description: Longest surface id kept.

exports.description: Parse one wire state; null when it carries no usable user.
exports.signature: <TCustom>(clientId: string, state: unknown, selfId: string, parseCustom?: CustomParser<TCustom>) => Peer<TCustom> | null

exports.name: PEER_PALETTE
exports.description: A pleasant, distinct palette for {@link colorFor}. Text drawn on these colours should use {@link readableTextOn}: several (amber, lime, cyan) are too light for white at small sizes.

exports.description: The peers (self excluded) whose selection on `surface` contains `id`: who is "on" this item.

exports.name: PRESENCE_STATUSES
exports.description: Presence statuses, in order of freshness. Canonical list.

props.name: y

props.name: zoom

exports.name: AWAY_AFTER_MS
exports.description: No input for this long → away (ms).

exports.name: createPresence
exports.description: Create a presence store over `adapter`.

exports.name: IDLE_AFTER_MS
exports.description: No input for this long → idle (ms).

exports.name: STATUS_CHECK_MS
exports.description: How often the store re-checks its own status (ms).

exports.name: statusAt
exports.description: The status a client should publish, from its last input and visibility. Pure: the decision the tests pin.

exports.name: LocalPatch
exports.description: What a host may change about its own published state.

exports.name: PresenceOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createPresence}.

exports.name: PresenceStore
exports.description: A live presence room.

exports.name: StatusPolicy
exports.description: When a client counts as idle or away.

exports.name: createMemoryHub
exports.description: Create an in-memory room (see {@link MemoryHub}).

exports.name: newClientId
exports.description: A per-client id (`crypto.randomUUID` where available, else a counter + time + random).

exports.name: CollabTransport
exports.description: A broadcast pipe to every OTHER member of one room.

exports.name: MemoryHub
exports.description: An in-memory room: every transport it hands out reaches the others. For two panes on one page, and for tests.

exports.name: MemoryHubOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link createMemoryHub}.

exports.name: broadcastTransport
exports.description: A {@link CollabTransport} over a BroadcastChannel named {@link BROADCAST_PREFIX} + `room`; null where BroadcastChannel does not exist (SSR, old browsers).

exports.name: trackActivity
exports.description: Report input inside `target` (default: the document) and page visibility to `presence`. Returns the unbind.

exports.name: leaveOnPageHide
exports.description: Say goodbye when the page is hidden for good (tab closed, navigated away) instead of lingering until the peers' timeout; come back if it is restored from the back/forward cache. Returns the unbind.

exports.name: pointInElement
exports.description: Where a client pointer is inside `el`, counting `el`'s scroll; null when outside it.
exports.signature: (el: Element, clientX: number, clientY: number) => LocalPoint | null

exports.name: prefersReducedMotion
exports.description: True when the user asked for less motion: cursors then jump instead of gliding.

exports.name: BROADCAST_PREFIX
exports.description: Prefix of every BroadcastChannel name, so a collab room never collides with an app's own channel.

exports.name: ACTIVITY_EVENTS
exports.description: Input events that count as activity. Canonical list.

exports.name: LocalPoint
exports.description: A point in an element's own (unscrolled, unscaled) coordinates.

exports.name: CollabProvider
exports.description: Puts a presence room in context for every hook below.

props.name: presence
props.description: The room this subtree talks to (from {@link usePresenceRoom}, or one the host made with `createPresence`).

props.name: trackActivity
props.description: Whether to report pointer, key and visibility to drive idle / away.

props.description: Count only input inside this element (default: the whole document).

exports.name: usePresenceStore
exports.description: The room in context; throws outside a {@link CollabProvider} so a missing provider is loud.

exports.name: usePresenceRoom
exports.description: Create a presence room for the component's lifetime (StrictMode-safe: the store is made in an effect). Null until mounted, or when offline.

exports.name: useMemoryHub
exports.description: One in-memory hub for the component's lifetime (made once; later option changes are ignored, use `hub.setLatency`).

exports.name: CollabRoom
exports.description:
A presence room and its provider in one unstyled element: {@link usePresenceRoom} + {@link CollabProvider},
with activity counted inside this element. Several rooms on one page (two "screens", one per panel) each
get their own idle / away. `data-collab-room` is `ready` once the room exists, `pending` before.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown until the room exists (first render, or while `adapter` returns null).

props.name: scopeActivity
props.description: Whether only input inside this room's element counts as this client's activity. False = the whole document.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the room's wrapper element.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that reads this room once it exists.

props.name: user
props.description: Who this client is, as shown to the others.

props.name: adapter
props.description: Makes the backend; called once per mount (and again when `key` changes). Returns null to stay offline.

props.name: key
props.description: Re-create the room when this changes (a room name).

props.name: idleAfterMs
props.description: Milliseconds without input before this client counts as idle.

props.name: awayAfterMs
props.description: Milliseconds without input before this client counts as away.

props.name: parseCustom
props.description: Validates peers' `custom` field; omitted = custom data is dropped on read.

exports.name: useOptionalPresenceStore
exports.description: The room in context, or null outside a {@link CollabProvider} (for parts that also take their data as props).

exports.name: usePeersIn
exports.description: Every client in `store` (self first), or an empty list when `store` is null. Never throws.

exports.name: usePeers
exports.description: Every client in the room, self first. Re-renders only when the room changes.

exports.name: useOthers
exports.description: Every client but this one.

exports.name: useSelf
exports.description: This client's own entry, once published.

exports.name: useCursorBroadcast
exports.description: Publish this client's pointer over `ref` as its cursor on `surface`; clears on leave. One frame of throttling.
exports.signature: (surface: string, ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, toSurface?: SurfaceMapper) => void

exports.name: useCursors
exports.description: The other clients whose cursor is on `surface`.

exports.name: useSharedSelection
exports.description: This client's selection on `surface`, published to the room. Uncontrolled by default; controlled with `options.value`.
exports.signature: (surface: string, options?: SharedSelectionOptions) => readonly [readonly string[], (ids: readonly string[]) => void]

exports.name: useSelectors
exports.description: The other clients selecting `id` on `surface`.

exports.name: useViewportBroadcast
exports.description: Publish this client's viewport on `surface` whenever it changes (what followers copy).

exports.name: useFollow
exports.description: Follow another client's viewport on `surface`: `apply` is called with each new viewport; following stops when they leave or when you call `stop` (wire it to your own pan).
exports.signature: (surface: string, apply: (viewport: ViewportState) => void, options?: FollowOptions) => FollowControls

exports.name: useHistory
exports.description: The history as data, re-rendering on change.

exports.name: useHistoryKeys
exports.description:
Mod+Z undoes, Mod+Shift+Z and Mod+Y redo, while focus is inside `ref` (or anywhere when no ref is
given). Typing fields keep their own undo. The keys are `@kitora/keyboard` commands: inside a
`KeyboardProvider` they join the host's keymap (remappable, listed in its cheatsheet); without one a
private engine handles them.
exports.signature: (source: HistorySource, ref?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, options?: HistoryKeysOptions) => void

props.name: source
props.description: The history the buttons undo and redo.

props.name: labels
props.type: { readonly undo?: string; readonly redo?: string }
props.description: Accessible names (default "Undo" / "Redo").

props.name: icons
props.type: { readonly undo?: ReactNode; readonly redo?: ReactNode }
props.description: Replace the icons.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the buttons' wrapper.

props.name: classNames
props.type: { readonly undo?: string; readonly redo?: string }
props.description: `undo` and `redo` style each button.

parts.name: Scrubber
parts.description: A range input over the history: drag to scrub through time.

props.name: source
props.description: The history to scrub through.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the range input.

parts.name: List
parts.description: Every step, newest at the bottom; click one to travel to it.

props.name: source
props.description: The history whose steps to list.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Formats a step's timestamp (epoch ms).

props.name: renderEntry
props.description: Replace a row's content (the button and its state stay).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown while there are no steps.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the list.

props.name: classNames
props.description: `row` styles each step's button.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The preset: header with Undo / Redo and a step count, the scrubber, and the step list. Built only from the parts above.

props.name: source
props.description: The history the panel shows and drives.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading text, also the panel's accessible name.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Formats a step's timestamp (passed to {@link HistoryList}, which defaults it to {@link formatClock}).

props.name: renderEntry
props.description: Replace a row's content (passed to {@link HistoryList}).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown while there are no steps (passed to {@link HistoryList}).

props.name: hideScrubber
props.description: Whether to hide the scrubber row.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the panel.

props.name: classNames
props.type: { readonly header?: string; readonly title?: string; readonly count?: string; readonly controls?: string; readonly scrubber?: string; readonly list?: string; readonly row?: string }
props.description: Classes for each part: `header`, `title`, `count`, `controls`, `scrubber`, `list` and each `row`.

exports.name: yAwarenessPresence

exports.name: connectYDoc
exports.description: Connect `doc` and its awareness to every peer on `transport`.
exports.signature: (doc: Y.Doc, transport: CollabTransport, opts?: YConnectOptions) => YConnection

exports.name: yUndoHistory
exports.description: A `Y.UndoManager` as a {@link HistorySource}. Steps without a label read as `fallbackLabel`.

exports.name: Y_MESSAGE_KINDS
exports.description: Wire message kinds of {@link connectYDoc}. Canonical list.

exports.name: Y_NAMESPACE
exports.description: Marker on every message, so presence and doc traffic can share one transport.

exports.name: SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS
exports.description: How long a joiner waits for a peer's state before treating itself as alone (ms).

exports.name: YConnectOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link connectYDoc}.

exports.name: YConnection
exports.description: A doc kept in sync with every peer on a transport.

exports.name: Y_LABEL_META
exports.description: The `meta` key a step's label is stored under on a Y.UndoManager stack item.

exports.name: YUndoHistory
exports.description: A Y.UndoManager history with labelled steps.
